explanation_short: The incremental feature analysis shows that adding more features generally improves model performance, with KNN achieving the highest R² score at 0.81717 when all 11 features are included.
explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis, presented in the table, demonstrates a clear trend of increasing model performance as more features are added to the model. For instance, the KNN model's R² score increases from 0.6449 with just 'VFA' to 0.8179 when all 11 features are used. This suggests that the predictive power of the target variable (HPR) is significantly enhanced by incorporating a broader set of chemical and physical measurements. The best overall performance across all models is achieved with the full set of 11 features, confirming the value of the comprehensive feature set for accurate prediction.
